data.long_meaning: Hussayn is a revered name in Islamic tradition, derived from the Arabic word 'hasuna', meaning 'to be good' or 'to be handsome'. It is also associated with Imam Hussayn, a grandson of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Hussayn carries the meaning “Good, Handsome” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hussayn usually hope their child will grow to embody good, handsome and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Martyr of Karbala, symbolizing courage and sacrifice
data.etymology: Hussayn belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good, Handsome.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hussayn total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
